body:
Tell Claude Code and the CI reviewer what kind of project this is, so their work and findings match its scope. Raised in chat on 2026-10-19, after the review of PR #51 asked for production-grade safeguards.

The project is a learning project, not production. Its focus is the agent side: the agents, their tools, memory, and evaluations. So it doesn't always follow production practice, and code quality, tests, and ops safeguards don't need to meet production standards. Agent evaluations are the exception.

## Do

- Write this scope into CLAUDE.md, where both Claude Code and the CI reviewer read it.
- In the same PR, remove the line PR #51 added at the end of `web/index.html` ("Triggers the code review for PR #51. Remove before merging."). It changes `web/`, so the CI review runs on the PR with the new context.
- Fix the workflow comment in `.github/workflows/code-review.yml` that says the allow rules in `.claude/settings.json` apply in CI. The CI log for PR #51 shows Claude Code ignores them, since the CI workspace isn't trusted.

## Done when

- The CI review on this PR runs, and its findings stay within the project's scope.

## Ends in

A PR.

**Settled in:** chat. Propose the CLAUDE.md wording to Joe in chat first, and write it in once he agrees.
